title: Do the Right Thing
tagline: Hottest day of the year. Coldest drinks in the house.
about: Tensions boil over at Sal's pizzeria on the hottest day of a Brooklyn summer.
cue: Turn the fan on and pour the drinks when Mookie makes his first delivery.
faces: Sal and the regulars, out on the block.
Sal's place. Sal's wall. Sun-faded since '64.
Six knots, melted butter, parsley, parmesan.
Ice cold, with mint, lime and chilli salt.
Shaved fine, our own syrup, fresh lemon.
Squeezed to order, plenty of ice.
Ice-cold lager, half and half, lemon wheel.
Cans from the cooler, ask at the register.
Twenty-five years on this block. Same oven, same recipe, same corner.
Prices subject to change. Free delivery on the block. Call 718 555 1989. Radios down, please. Sidewalk swept daily by Vito.

    StartersGarlic KnotsSix knots, melted butter, parsley, parmesan.From Sal's oven while you wait.How to make it500g pizza dough50g butter3 garlic cloves, crushed1 bunch parsley30g grated parmesanCut the dough into 12 strips and tie each into a knot.Rest the knots on a tray to prove until puffy.Bake at 230°C until golden.Melt the butter with the garlic and chopped parsley, toss the hot knots through and shower with parmesan.Watermelon & Feta SticksIce cold, with mint, lime and chilli salt.The only cool thing on the block today.How to make it1kg seedless watermelon, chilled200g firm feta1 bunch mint1 lime1 tsp flaky sea salt1/2 tsp chilli flakes16 skewersCut the watermelon into 3cm cubes and the feta into 2cm cubes.Thread onto the skewers, alternating with small mint leaves.Mix the salt, chilli flakes and lime zest, squeeze the lime juice over the skewers and sprinkle with the chilli salt. Serve straight from the fridge.MainsPepperoni SliceCrushed tomato, mozzarella, oregano.Big slices, cut by Sal. Extra cheese costs extra.How to make it500g pizza dough400g crushed tomatoes250g grated low-moisture mozzarella100g pepperoni1 tsp dried oregano1 tsp saltRest the dough at room temperature for an hour. Season the tomatoes with salt.Stretch the bases thin and spread with the sauce. Top with the mozzarella and pepperoni.Bake on a preheated tray at the oven's highest setting until bubbling and charred in spots. Sprinkle with oregano and cut big.SweetsCherry IceShaved fine, our own syrup, fresh lemon.For the heat on the block.How to make it300g cherries, pitted150g caster sugar150ml water1 lemon, juiced1kg icePit the cherries.Simmer the cherries with the sugar, water and lemon juice, then strain.Cool and chill the syrup until cold.Shave or crush the ice into four cups and pour the syrup over just before serving.DrinksBeer & LemonadeIce-cold lager, half and half, lemon wheel.Da Mayor's kind of cold.How to make it4 bottles of lager3 lemons80g caster sugar300ml cold water2 cups iceJuice the lemons and stir the juice with the sugar and cold water until dissolved. Keep a few lemon wheels for the glasses.Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer.Half-fill each glass with ice-cold lager, top with lemonade, then add ice and a lemon wheel. Serve straight away.
